references.text: God set apart the Levites from the people of Israel for His service, demonstrating their special calling and election.
The Levites were given to Aaron to serve at the tabernacle and stand before the congregation.
The Levites were appointed to care for the tabernacle and its service.
The tribe of Levi was brought near to serve and carry out the work at the tent of meeting.
The Lord set apart the tribe of Levi to bear the ark of the covenant, stand before the presence of the Lord, and serve Him.
Aaron and his sons were set apart from the people of Israel to perform priestly duties.
God set Israel apart from the nations, and the Levites were set apart for holy service.
Aaron was set apart to consecrate the Most Holy Place and perform priestly service before the Lord.
The Levites were to serve in the sanctuary and stand before the people to minister to them.
Believers are a chosen people, a royal priesthood, set apart to proclaim God's great works.
